Advanced settings & full rescan

If a website omits category metadata, unverified chats are skipped unless Ordinary Recents is checked. Unchecking a category never deletes chats already archived in SQLite.

Rescan selected chats

Re-evaluate older conversations from scratch using your current checklist. Existing messages are never duplicated.

Local capture does not grant Google permission. CLI approval covers future updates until revoked. NotebookLM sync: ai-memory approve → ai-memory sync
